verdict.rationale: Vapi documents speech-configuration controls to determine 'exactly when your assistant starts and stops speaking during a conversation' (vapi-docs-53), which implies some interruption/turn-taking control, and background denoising and call-timeout settings touch adjacent turn-taking behavior (vapi-docs-51, vapi-docs-44). However there is no explicit documentation of barge-in detection, context updating after interruption, or turn-recovery mechanics, nor any hands-on/community evidence confirming graceful interruption handling in practice. Missing for 10: explicit barge-in/interruption-handling documentation, evidence of context state update after interruption, and independent/community validation of graceful recovery.
